assertions.source: D₅(ζ₅x)⁵(1−x⁵) − D₅(x)⁵(1−x)⁵ ≡ 0 in ℚ(ζ₅)[x] (GK eq after (9)), exact polynomial identity.

assertions.name: zeta5_branch_invariance_exact

assertions.name: quadrature_validated_at_N1
assertions.source: direct Faddeev-integral quadrature vs GK closed form (2) at b=1: |Δ| ≈ 5e-9 (double-precision tensor Gauss–Legendre).

assertions.name: assembled_cor12_equals_direct_integral
assertions.source: assembled Cor 1.2 evaluation at b²=1/5 vs direct state integral ∫Φ_b(x)²e^{−πix²}dx — end-to-end gold check of the entire transcription (root of unity, Rogers branches, (1−z)^{13/10}, 1-loop (1+z)/(1−z), /D₅ branches, G₅⁺).

assertions.name: no_vacuum_row_match_exact
assertions.source: exact in-field comparisons |c±|¹⁰ = ((5∓√5)/10)⁵ (i.e. |c±| = (2/√5)sin(kπ/5)) are all FALSE; 40-digit numerics separated by factors ≈7–11. The D₅ product does NOT reproduce the Σ(2,3,5) vacuum row.

description: B4 residue of the Vector-2 double pincer: the Garoufalidis–Kashaev (arXiv:1411.6062) cyclic quantum dilogarithm D₅ product evaluated on the explicit 4₁ state-integral data ((A,B)=(1,2), g(z)=−z(1−z)⁻², z± = e(±1/6)) at b² = 1/5. Exact results in ℚ(ζ₃₀): (/D₅(θ;ζ₅))⁵ is real with minpoly x⁴−46x³−94x²+79x+1 (θ₊=ζ₃₀) / x⁴+29x³−69x²+29x+1 (θ₋=ζ₆); the state sums G₅⁺ are real with minpolys x⁴−60x³+960x²−5175x+6525 / x⁴−60x³+885x²−4500x+6525 — all degree 4, generating the FULL real quartic field ℚ(ζ₃₀)⁺, not ℚ(√5). The assembled Cor 1.2 evaluation I_{1,2}(1/√5) = (1/√5)[c₊e^{−V/10π} + c₋e^{V/10π}] (|c₊|≈5.97438, |c₋|≈5.53868) matches the DIRECT Faddeev state integral to quadrature precision (~2e-9 scale; quadrature itself validated at b=1 against GK eq (2)). The icosahedral Σ(2,3,5) vacuum-row entries (2/√5)sin(kπ/5) do NOT appear: exact in-field comparisons |c±|¹⁰ = ((5∓√5)/10)⁵ all FALSE. Scope-(a): the GK leg closes; the only √5 in the 4₁ evaluation remains the Gauss-sum prefactor 1/√N = 1/√5; m stays OPEN; nothing wired.

exact_values.field: all four values generate the full real quartic ℚ(ζ₃₀)⁺; each minpoly factors over ℚ(√5) into two quadratics (ℚ(√5) is the quadratic subfield) but none lies in ℚ(√5)

caveats: Scope-(a): 'the cyclic-dilogarithm product on the explicit 4₁ data, alone, does not reproduce the icosahedral vacuum-row entries.' The shared object between the exchange ceiling, the Gauss sum and the S-matrix normalization remains the bare algebraic number √5 — no object-level map, anti-numerology gate in full force. |c±| involve principal-branch 5th roots ( /D₅ is multivalued; the assembled sum is branch-invariant per E4 and is pinned end-to-end by the direct integral E6). m ∈ (0, 1/√5) remains OPEN; nothing wired.
